species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 54°F on top, warmer than they like, so they go deeper and into the shade.
Best water today is 42–142 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 80 ft, cold below.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 54°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 38–42 ft deep, mostly on drop-offs.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 80 ft, cold below.

species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 54°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 78–84 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 80 ft, cold below.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 54°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–34 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 80 ft, cold below.
West wind at 20 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
